name: taptap-maker
description: Develop TapTap Maker projects locally with the official CLI and MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Maker projects, preview locally, and submit builds.
interface.longDescription: Create a new Maker project or connect an existing workspace with the official CLI. Develop UrhoX/Lua games, preview with Maker Runtime, and submit builds to Maker. A Maker account is required for project access and remote operations.
defaultPrompt: Check this TapTap Maker project's connection and local development setup.
Develop a small playable game in this TapTap Maker project.
Run a local preview of this Maker project and inspect its logs.
